evals.prompt: This is a 3-phase feature touching about 12 files across modules. Run it with an architect, builder and reviewer.
evals.expected_output: Dispatches Architect (Opus), Builder (Sonnet), Reviewer (Sonnet) with the plan file as the handoff.
assertions: Architect (opus) reads the codebase and writes a phased plan to ~/.claude/plans/<task>.md with boundaries and acceptance criteria
Builder (sonnet) implements from the plan and stages changes
Reviewer (sonnet) validates the diff and runs tests, reporting pass/fail per phase
Stops with BLOCKED if the Architect plan is missing or unparseable instead of dispatching Builder and Reviewer

evals.prompt: This task was flagged CRITICAL and will take several hours. Use the three-man team.
evals.expected_output: Uses the pattern because the task meets the when-to-use criteria.
assertions: Recognizes CRITICAL, over 2 hours, 3+ phases or over 5 files as qualifying
Dispatches all three roles rather than one agent

evals.prompt: Fix a typo in the error message in one file.
evals.expected_output: Tiny change; the 3-agent overhead is unjustified.
assertions: Does not dispatch Architect, Builder and Reviewer
